data.long_meaning: One who is skilled, able, competent, and efficient in work. The name Kusal carries the meaning “Skilled, able” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Kusal usually hope their child will grow to embody skilled, able and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kusal total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
